newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close mixed.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Wednesday after some months recovered from earlier losses on technical buying by local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 130 yen lower to 50 yen higher, with the benchmark November 1997 contract up 50 yen at 13,700 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 50,688 lots.
All contracts fell in the early morning, reflecting a weaker CBOT corn market overnight and the yen's gains against the dollar, traders said.
The market experienced light technical buying by some speculators in the afternoon, they said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.65-1/2 per bushel at 0815 GMT, against $2.66-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
The spot January contract of CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.88 per bushel at 0815 GMT, steady from Tuesday's close.
